_SecretsNote: API keys, client secrets, and connection strings are stored in Windows Credential Manager (encrypted per-user). Use the Secret Setup dialog to configure them.

ActiveDirectory._DomainName_comment: FQDN or NetBIOS name of the domain (e.g. 'si-eng.local' or 'SI-ENG'). Required for non-domain-joined machines via VPN. Leave empty for auto-detect on domain-joined machines.

WebView2._MaxUploadFileSizeMb_comment: Max file size (MB) for automatic ACC upload and ZIP extraction. Files larger than this trigger a confirmation dialog.

Logging._CentralLogPath_comment: UNC or local path for centralized error logging across all users. Each user gets a subfolder by username. Empty = disabled. Example: \\server\llog

Autodesk._CreateOfficeInboxPlatform_comment: AccNative = use new ACC Admin API (recommended), LegacyBim360 = use legacy HQ API
Autodesk._BootstrapAdminEmail_comment: Email of user to assign as Project Admin when creating ACC-native projects. Required for Docs enablement.
Autodesk._DryRun_comment: When true, no mutating API calls are made - only logs what would happen
Autodesk._OAuthRedirectPort_comment: Port for OAuth callback listener. MUST match the Callback URL in APS Console exactly. Default: 8080

Ollama._comment: Local Ollama server for AI-powered Hebrew note review. Model must be pre-pulled (e.g. ollama pull gemma4:26b).
